tags.feature: Added an "All" button to the Quintessence menu
Map can now be toggled between "Small." "Large," and "Off"
Added "Reflective Water" Rite to Doll's Shop. One time enemy analysis items.
Added a progression block in Dis, a key is now required to progress to the Back Alley. This was meant to encourage the player to explore the lower level areas first.
Added an array of new items to the Quintessence shop in the area to better show what the system can do.
Mascot Charm - If the user strikes a weakpoint, apply [Aggression] to the user.
[Aggression]: Gain an extra action on the next turn. Does not stack.
Devil Tongue - Increases chance of Flesh skills dropping items.
Yellow Bile - [Poisoned] has a chance to apply [Attack DOWN], [Defense DOWN], or [Speed DOWN].
Blessed Inhaler - Increases the amount of Stamina (ST) restored by Rest.
Morbid Charm - When [Rest] is used, apply [Defense Up].
Fluffy Pillow - When [Rest] is used, apply [Attack Up].
Lidless Thermos - [Frozen] enemies take increased fire damage; [Burning] enemies take increased ice damage
Knife Sharpener - Metal attacks have an increased chance of inflicting [Bleeding]

tags.balance_change: Moved location of the Apartments to the Docks.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where a demon would leave combat in a group during communion, and the battle theme would fail to resume.
Fixed the broken items in the Lizard Woman Communion route. She now gives the Quintessence [Abyssal Magazine].
Fixed a progression break in the Leo/Jersey quest line.
Text during the fight against Stare no longer auto-progresses.
Fixed a bug that caused the item crystal behind the fake wall in Lower Dis to not give anything. It now gives [Warm Broach].
Fixed the effects on certain status effects to properly reflect description.

notes.title: Aug 2024 Development Update
notes.content:
[h3]UPDATE[/h3]
Crazy as it sounds, we've crossed over [i]1 YEAR[/i] since [b]Zenith[/b] was [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2393290/allnews/]originally slated[/url] to release...

Nikki has been running monthly updates over on the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/982238101/they-speak-from-the-abyss]Kickstarter page[/url]. As those are limited to backers of the main game, we thought it was high time we ran a new update on the Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393290/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss_Zenith/

[h3]WHAT HAPPENED?[/h3]
There isn't really any one single thing that slowed down the production of Zenith. This projected was begun as a trial to iron out any kinks ahead of tackling the FULL release.

Piece by piece, as Zenith was added to and improved upon, it would shine a spotlight on other areas that were no longer up to par. Often this sort of revisionist approach would be the death of a game. But this was done by design here! Even if our estimates on the timeline were significantly off...

Through private playtests, attending events, and any other feedback that could be gathered - it became much more clear where work was needed, all while laying the groundwork for the final title!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/68a87c9d501cb9d624bfc295fc19a5577eb88408.png[/img]
[h3]WHAT'S CHANGED?[/h3]
As a breakdown since you last heard from us:
[list]
[*] Nikki spent some time honing her 3D modeling, and was able to give the game a MAJOR update on visuals
[*] The choice was made to drop the 4:3 ratio (which also meant redoing a bunch of UI and other art) as can be seen in the all new screenshots!
[*] The combat was overhauled to be more interesting
[*] The UI was completely redone
[*] Cutscene revisions
[*] Dialogue rewrites
[*] Endless bug fixes and improvements to how the game renders and runs![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/6f9663d8979c614f6a1ab591fb05c1df0f26acb2.png[/img]
[h3]RELEASE?[/h3]
While we're still not quite ready to set a new launch date, the game is well underway, with a [b]brand new demo[/b] nearing completion!

We also officially moved the main [b]THEY SPEAK[/b] game back to "2025".
While a lot of the foundations will already be laid through Zenith, it is a MUCH larger title. So development will be notably faster, but is still anticipated to be a [i]lengthy[/i] process!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075460/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss/

There is art on that page that is already over 2 years old!!
When we're ready to launch Zenith, we'll be sure that page receives a revision to reflect the changes in style and gameplay.

Thank you all for your patience!
I'm confident it will be well worth the wait - especially for all you lovely Kickstarter backers who are now getting TWO games for the price of one ;)

-Graeme
(2 Left Thumbs)

notes.title: Realms Deep 2023 & Development Update
notes.content:
[h2]REALMS DEEP 2023[/h2]
We are [i]thrilled[/i] to have [b]Zenith[/b] chosen to take part in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RealmsDeep2023?snr=1_5_9_]Realms Deep 2023[/url]! This project has always been rather niche. So having an event as prominent and well regarded as Realms Deep single us out is both incredibly flattering, and motivating!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/053a529d3eb9c00b757e16db5d238f4c71a59835.png[/img]

We fully intended to have a playable version available for this event. Our apologies to anyone who landed on this page from the "Games with Demos" category. I don't think there's any way to drop out of that list at this stage?? The [i]why[/i] is a bit longer of a story...

[h2]DEVELOPMENT UPDATE[/h2]
[b]Zenith[/b] is a standalone Prequel to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075460/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss/]They Speak From The Abyss[/url]. This isn't a glorified demo, uploaded as a "Prologue", which has become a rather common developer trick here on Steam. While [b]Zenith[/b] features locations and character from the Main Game, it is fully it's own game and experience!

[h3]Zenith will no longer be free[/h3]
Our initial decision to make this Prequel available for Free was made when the game was a fraction of it's current size. [b]Zenith[/b] was originally conceived [u]7 MONTHS[/u] ago!! The project has grown a LOT since then! As an example, the game now features over [b]50 unique monsters[/b], and [b]30 originals tracks[/b] in the OST.

With a growing scope, a challenging move to a new city mid-development, followed by Unity fully melting down - we had to re-evaluate a lot of things. It was decided that development will continue in Unity (starting over would be too costly), but not after [i]weeks[/i] spent agonizing over whether that was still feasible. Especially when Free releases could potentially end up [i]costing[/i] money to release with Unity's new Runtime Fee. That situation is a mess...

It took quite some time to come to terms with it - but [b]Zenith[/b] will now be a paid release. We promise the price tag on this game won't break the bank! It will likely be somewhere close to $5 at launch.

No release date is set - and unfortunately due to missing our original release target, we are unable to change it to anything other than the "Coming Soon" you currently see. A demo is in the works, and will be announced on [url=https://twitter.com/TheFifthKalpa]Nikki's twitter[/url] as soon as it's available! And be sure to [u][b]Wishlisht[/b][/u] the full game so you are notified for it's full release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393290/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss_Zenith/

-Graeme
(2 Left Thumbs)
